heldout_initial_conditions: Early reports use 12 small random joint-velocity perturbations. Final native validation additionally includes one exact zero-velocity initial state. Browser evaluation uses its actual zero-velocity reset and its own WASM MuJoCo implementation.
interpretation: Native and browser long-horizon yaw can differ. A no-regression admission pass alone does not establish straight-line walking; keep speed, fall, direction and backend results separate.
